literal.prompt: Какой орган управляет работой нервной системы и обрабатывает сигналы органов чувств?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The prompt asks which organ governs nervous-system work and processes sensory signals; OpenStax identifies the brain as a main nervous-system organ and says sensory information passes through and is processed by the thalamus. The four options are all organs; their own-option facts are separately evidenced.

literalGroups.literal: Головной мозг — центральный орган нервной системы в полости черепа. Его отделы отвечают за восприятие, движение и регуляцию функций организма.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The existing explanation says the brain is the central nervous-system organ, and its regions take part in perception, movement and body regulation. OpenStax identifies brain as a main nervous-system organ (L31), higher functions as cerebral function (L37,L41), and hypothalamus as regulating homeostasis (L94).
Spleen is a secondary lymphoid organ; it filters microbes and other material, including dying red cells, from blood.
